text: The windbreak outside the grain shed has come loose. The artisan says replacing the boards will take some wood; if we want to spare it, we will have to stop the work at hand and tie everything down together with rope.

The city's maintenance crew installed new windbreak boards for the storage area.
The new boards have been nailed down tight, keeping the cold wind outside.

Reinforce together
The city temporarily reassigned workers to reinforce the storage area. Production is delayed this round.
Everyone set aside their work and used hemp rope to cinch the loose windbreak tight again.
The cold wave warning arrived half a day early. The people on duty used 4 units of wood to reinforce the grain shed's windbreak, without interrupting the work at hand.
